character_decisions.subject: Inaria, age 20, Taiwanese/Asian adult woman
character_decisions.identity_anchor: Use the age-20 standard portrait as the primary identity reference. Preserve the recognizable face, face shape, major facial structure, core facial proportions, dark blue-black hair, blue eyes, and intended adult body proportions.
character_decisions.presentation: Clearly adult, healthy, natural, and age-20 appropriate; avoid childlike styling or facial cues.
character_decisions.expression: Quiet, confident three-quarter gaze with a subtle relaxed smile; natural facial tension and asymmetry, not an exaggerated expression.
character_decisions.hair: Variable shoulder-length dark blue-black hair with a soft side part and restrained loose waves. Keep the color unmistakably blue-black and preserve the visible forehead, hairline, and facial silhouette needed for identity recognition.
character_decisions.clothing: Refined deep teal wrap blouse with a modest V neckline, fitted but natural structure, paired with a high-waisted warm-gray pleated skirt. Add small understated silver earrings; no distracting logos or identity-confounding accessories.
character_decisions.scene: Quiet conservatory interior with pale window frames, soft green foliage, and a muted stone bench. Keep background secondary and uncluttered so the face and body silhouette remain legible.
character_decisions.pose: Seated upright in a relaxed three-quarter pose, torso turned slightly toward camera, shoulders level, one forearm resting naturally on the thigh and the other hand lightly holding the skirt edge. Legs angled together with both feet grounded and visible enough for anatomy inspection.
character_decisions.camera: Three-quarter medium-full portrait at approximately eye level, 50mm-equivalent perspective, mild natural background separation, no wide-angle distortion. Compose from head through feet with adequate margin around hands and toes.
character_decisions.lighting: Soft diffused daylight from camera-left with gentle fill from the front; preserve natural translucent skin, dimensional facial planes, and subtle light-shadow transitions.
character_decisions.style: Romantic, refined, dreamy Japanese-inspired portrait treatment with clean detail, believable anatomy, restrained color harmony, and no plastic smoothing.

locked_constraints: Preserve Inaria's recognizable identity and facial structure from the age-20 standard portrait.
Preserve dark blue-black hair and blue eyes.
Preserve intended body proportions and plausible adult anatomy.
Maintain natural Taiwanese/Asian facial presentation without caricature or ethnicity drift.
Hands must have exactly five plausible fingers each; fingers must be separated, correctly attached, and naturally posed.
Feet must have exactly five plausible toes each when visible; no extra, missing, fused, duplicated, or hidden malformed digits.
No extra limbs, impossible joints, severe deformation, broken wrists or ankles, or implausible balance.
Avoid wrong face, apparent age drift, incorrect hair color, exaggerated makeup, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, or generic identity replacement.
Keep the face unobstructed by hair, hands, props, or heavy shadow.
No text, watermark, logo, unintended duplicate subject, or distracting accessory.
Maintain readable body silhouette and enough framing to inspect anatomy.

intentional_variations.clothing: Introduce a sophisticated teal-and-warm-gray outfit distinct from a standard portrait while keeping the neckline modest and the face unobstructed.
intentional_variations.hairstyle: Use a soft side part with loose waves rather than a fixed standard hairstyle; retain dark blue-black color and stable facial framing.
intentional_variations.scene: Use a daylight conservatory instead of a plain portrait background to add controlled environmental diversity.
intentional_variations.pose: Use a grounded seated three-quarter pose with relaxed hands and visible feet, providing variation while prioritizing balance and anatomy inspection.
intentional_variations.camera: Use an eye-level 50mm-equivalent medium-full composition rather than a tight headshot or dramatic angle.
intentional_variations.expression: Use a subtle confident smile and calm gaze rather than a neutral expression.
intentional_variations.lighting: Use gentle directional window light with soft fill, maintaining facial detail and natural skin translucency.
intentional_variations.composition: Place Inaria slightly off-center with foliage and window geometry as low-contrast framing elements; keep the face as the strongest visual anchor.

notes.production_guidance: Generate a single integrated image using the locked identity reference and the specified controlled variations. Keep decorative detail subordinate to identity, proportions, anatomy, and facial readability.
notes.quality_gate: PASS only if identity remains recognizable, the subject reads clearly as age 20, hair remains dark blue-black, eyes remain blue, proportions remain stable, and both hands and visible feet pass the exact-digit anatomy check.
notes.repair_policy: Any repaired image requires a complete recheck of identity, age presentation, facial structure, hair color, proportions, hands, feet, joints, balance, skin texture, and unwanted artifacts.
rejection_triggers: Identity drift or generic replacement face
Incorrect apparent age or childlike presentation
Wrong hair color or eye color
Malformed hands or feet, including digit errors
Extra limbs, impossible joints, or implausible seated balance
Plastic skin, excessive smoothing, or exaggerated makeup
Face obscured or rendered too small for identity verification
Strong lens distortion, clutter, text, watermark, or duplicate subject
notes.dataset_role: This image adds clothing, conservatory-scene, seated-pose, soft-wave-hairstyle, eye-level medium-full-camera, and gentle-smile diversity without introducing accidental identity signals.
